discovery.instructions: This server provides SDAR task-capable tools.

tools.name: vehicle_get_state
tools.description: Read the normalized local UGV state without referee or global-truth data.

tools.name: vehicle_get_capabilities
tools.description: Read device-reported UGV capability facts without inventing unsupported limits.

tools.name: vehicle_get_payload_status
tools.description: Read local UGV payload, gimbal, laser and task status.

tools.name: vehicle_get_targets
tools.description: Read targets observed by local UGV sensors only.

tools.name: vehicle_navigate
tools.description: Run a point, route, distance or return-home chassis mission.

tools.name: vehicle_track_target
tools.description: Track a locally observed target and fail locally when lock is lost.

tools.name: vehicle_control_gimbal
tools.description: Run a finite absolute, relative, or reset electro-optical gimbal adjustment.

tools.name: vehicle_fire_weapon
tools.description: Execute one confirmed local fire-control cycle without hit, damage or destruction semantics.

tools.name: vehicle_emergency_stop
tools.description: Preempt and stop only this UGV's local tracks.
